<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Inspection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/energy-drink-bottling-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inspection" name="Start inspection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineDetails" name="Enter machine type and serial number"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerQuestions" name="Answer inspection questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressButtons" name="Press machine buttons"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectAndShowValues" name="Collect and show machine values"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" name="Are additional questions needed?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" name="Answer additional questions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions" name="Continue inspection"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Inspection" name="Inspection complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToDetails" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inspection" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetailsToQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineDetails" targetRef="Task_AnswerQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuestionsToButtons" sourceRef="Task_AnswerQuestions" targetRef="Task_PressButtons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ButtonsToCollect" sourceRef="Task_PressButtons" targetRef="Task_CollectAndShowValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToDecision" sourceRef="Task_CollectAndShowValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_YesAdditionalQuestions" name="Additional questions needed" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalQuestionsRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsToMerge" sourceRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="EndEvent_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description identifies multiple required activities within a phase, requires all of them before that phase can end, and specifies no order among them: Model the activities as parallel branches synchronized by a parallel gateway.
rules.situation: the description presents multiple required activities within the same phase without specifying an order between them

rules.instruction: When the description states a specific activity, decision, or outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN element with wording that preserves the described action and its object or result; do not substitute a related but different action or outcome.
rules.situation: the description states a specific activity, decision, or outcome

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes human-performed interactions from automated collection or presentation of information: Model them as separate BPMN activities and use a service task for the automated work.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes human-performed interactions from automated collection or presentation of information

rules.instruction: When the description presents activities in an order, states a decision outcome that leads to an activity, or identifies an event that determines what happens next.: Connect each stated transition with a sequence flow, including from the start event to the first activity, from each decision branch to its specified next step, and from an event-based gateway to its catching-event target.
rules.situation: the description states an order between activities or says that a later action depends on an earlier action or result
